Common-uniform coupling contracts weighted Hamming distance; finite-state existence, uniqueness, geometric convergence follow. At stationarity Es=0, C=BCB+D with diagonal D>=0; boundary D11>0. The positive path series Σ B^t D(B^t)^T proves all off-diagonal signs and parity zeros at h=1/2. Two-step transition kernel then splits by parity, and uniqueness for P² proves full block independence. For m=2 exact two-spin stationary moment q satisfies q=2h(1-2h)+((1-2h)^2+h^2)q, hence covariance formula. final_claim: For m>=2 interior sites with boundaries held at 1/2 and independent complete-step Bernoulli rounding of the heat Euler stencil, for 0<h<=1/2 the stationary law is unique, has Bernoulli(1/2) marginals and positive off-diagonal covariances except that at h=1/2 opposite-parity blocks are fully independent while within-block pairs remain positively correlated. In m=2 the model remains valid 0<h<2/3 with exact covariance (1-2h)/(2(4-5h)), negative beyond h=1/2.
limitations: m>=2 with constant half reservoirs, 0<h<=1/2; only m=2 extends to 0<h<2/3.
No claim for IEEE stochastic rounding, correlated random streams or higher-dimensional PDE meshes.
